projectsPage.intro: Here are some of my projects that I have worked on. Each project is a reflection of my skills and passion for software development. I have applied various technologies and methodologies to create scalable and maintainable applications.

react-tailwind-generator.title: React Tailwind Generator (NPM)
react-tailwind-generator.description: A powerful CLI tool designed to automate the creation of React components pre-configured with Tailwind CSS. It streamlines the development workflow by generating consistent boilerplates, folder structures, and styling configurations in seconds.
react-tailwind-generator.learn: I mastered the Node.js CLI ecosystem, specifically working with Inquirer.js for interactive prompts and File System (FS) modules for automated scaffolding. I also implemented a robust publishing pipeline on the NPM registry and managed versioning and dependencies for public consumption.

quiz-app.title: Quiz App Mastery
quiz-app.description: A dynamic and interactive quiz platform featuring real-time score tracking, category selection, and progress animations. The application focuses on providing a seamless user experience with high-performance state transitions.
quiz-app.learn: Deep dive into Vue 3 Composition API and reactive state management. I implemented automated unit testing using Vitest to ensure component reliability and focused on TypeScript's strict typing to eliminate runtime errors during complex data handling.

password-generator.title: Secure Password Generator
password-generator.description: A high-security tool that generates customizable, cryptographically strong passwords. Users can adjust length and character sets (symbols, numbers, uppercase) with an instant 'copy to clipboard' feature.
password-generator.learn: I deepened my understanding of Vanilla JavaScript by implementing complex algorithms for randomization. I focused on DOM manipulation without frameworks and handled browser Clipboard APIs while ensuring a responsive UI with CSS Variables.

portfolio.title: Professional Tech Portfolio
portfolio.description: A high-performance, responsive showcase of my engineering journey. It features multi-language support (i18n), dark mode, and dynamic project filtering, serving as a living resume of my technical evolution.
portfolio.learn: Mastered the art of SEO optimization and accessibility (A11y) standards. I implemented a clean architecture for internationalization (i18n) and used advanced CSS techniques like Grid and Flexbox to ensure pixel-perfect rendering across all device sizes.

checkers-game.title: Desktop Checkers Strategy
checkers-game.description: A fully functional desktop implementation of the classic Checkers game. It includes move validation logic, a graphical board interface, and local multiplayer capabilities with a focus on low-level performance.
checkers-game.learn: I applied Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles in C++ and mastered the Qt Framework for GUI development. I learned to manage memory efficiently and handle complex event-driven logic for game state synchronization and move detection.
